newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Transcom says to buy Collins.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Transcom says to buy Collins.

text.p: Transcom International Ltd said on Monday it had entered into an agreement to acquire engine technology firm Collins Motor Corporation Ltd
"All shares in Collins will be cancelled and Collins' shareholders will receive one new A$0.20 share in Transcom for each share cancelled in Collins," Transcom said in a statement.
The transaction values Collins at A$7.54 million.
Transcom said it would seek to raise additional capital through a share issue but did not give details.

Transcom said it would become a major participant in both the heavy and light engine market on a worldwide basis through the supply of electronic engine control systems technology and associate products and the Collins Sytech engine system.

"The acquisition of Collins will give Transcom access to the small engine market by providing an opportunity to apply Transcom's electronic control systems technology to Collins' Sytech engine technology," it said.
Transcom also has significant programmes underway with other major heavy duty engine manufacturers involving the development of natural gas heavy duty vehicle engines.
Transcom said it had appointed Collins director Robert Rooke to head Transcom Engine Corporation Ltd.
The purchase was expected to be completed by the end of the first quarter of 1997, Transcom said.
